items.title: Citi Japan’s Tokenized Deposit Launch Extends the Institutional Pivot Into Asia’s Deepest Regulatory Framework
items.summary: Citi is bringing its tokenized deposit remittance services to Japan According to Nikkei Asia, Citigroup will offer blockchain-based tokenized deposit remittance services for Japanese corporate clients as early as the end of 2026. items.title: UiPath Slips 3% Despite Citi Buy Initiation and $23 Target, Pegasystems and C3.ai Lag
items.summary: Citi just slapped a Buy rating on UiPath with a target nearly 70% above the current price, yet shares keep falling. Here is what the bull and bear camps are fighting over ahead of a high-stakes investor day that could flip the narrative.

items.title: Is It Worth Investing in Citigroup (C) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
items.summary: According to the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), one should invest in Citigroup (C). It is debatable whether this highly sought-after metric is effective because Wall Street analysts' recommendations tend to be overly optimistic. Would it be worth investing in the stock?

items.title: Citi turns more bullish on trucking stocks
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi has turned more positive on trucking and logistics stocks, upgrading Old Dominion Freight Line and C.H. Robinson to Buy in a note Tuesday after both fell from their summer highs.

items.title: After an 18% summer selloff in chip stocks, Citi asks what comes next
items.summary: Investing.com -- Citi told clients in a note Tuesday that it expects semiconductor stocks to rebound after a summer slump, arguing that a heavy conference schedule and resilient data center demand should support a sector that had run ahead of expectations.
